notes.title: Free Dead Cells update adds goodies based on Hotline Miami, Slay The Spire and more
notes.content:
Fantasy roguelike Dead Cells is being invaded by indies again. Weapons and outfits from six games are making their way into the game with today's free Everone Is Here 2 update: Terraria, Hotline Miami, Shovel Knight, Slay The Spire, Risk Of Rain 2, and Katana Zero. There’s also new lore rooms based on locations from these games, which is where you’ll find the weapons stored. You can watch some of the costumes and weapons in action in the trailer below.

notes.title: Katana Zero cuts deep with a brutal Hard Mode update
notes.content:
Katana Zero was a lovely game — a side-scrolling samurai Hotline Miami — but perhaps a little on the short side. Ending on a maddening cliffhanger, developer Askiisoft says there’s more levels and story in the works as free DLC. Until then, they’re putting players through the wringer. Two new modes were added in a big patch yesterday, Speedrun mode and Hard Mode. The former offers a cutscene-lite deterministic playing field. Hard Mode, unlocked after beating the main story, is designed to murder you in a thousand fun new ways. Oh, and you can pet a cat now.

(more…)

notes.title: Speedrun Mode | Hard Mode | 20% Off
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25282473/72d2ab395deba4f2bbddf4990871162f757c65f9.png[/img]

The first major update for Katana ZERO is now live with new post-game content, new achievements, fixes / tweaks, and patented Cat Petting Tech. The game is also 20% off for a limited time and we appreciate your support and spreading the news to friends and sworn enemies.

Hard Mode: After completing the game, unlock Hard Mode with an escalating difficulty for master assassins. Includes new enemy types, revamped levels, reworked bosses, and all new challenges. This mode is accessed through the Speedrun Mode menu.

Speedrun Mode: Time your assault with options for stable enemy behavior, scene skipping, expansive statistics and more. Speedruns auto-save, so you can quit mid-run and resume later.

Fixed Optional Stealth Level: You know the one... Enemies in that level now have consistent patrol patterns and are a little more lenient.

Also, new achievements, petting the cat, bug fixes, and quality of life improvements!

Thank you for your continued support of Katana ZERO! More free DLC - including story content and levels - is in the works.

notes.title: Katana Zero is getting Hard mode, Speedrun mode in big update this month
notes.content:
Developer Askiisoft has revealed that its wonderful, neon-drenched action extravaganza Katana Zero will be getting a whole bunch of new additions in a "significant update" due on Switch and PC at the end of the month.

Katana Zero, if you've not yet had the pleasure, plays out something like Hotline Miami meets Groundhog day, casting players as a sword-wielding, drug-addled assassin and then setting them loose across enemy-packed levels where one wrong move means instant death.

The trick, then, is to chain your small but powerful set of moves together with absolute precision, clearing the room with a swift set of dodges, deflections, and sword slashes. If you mess up though, and you likely will at first, a full rewind is just a button away, meaning you can try over and over until you nail the level in one breathlessly balletic display of blood and steel.
